chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi, who said:

Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: The one who performs Ziyarah of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) on the fifteenth of Sha'ban, his sins will be forgiven, and no bad deed will be recorded against him in that year until the year passes. And if he performs Ziyarah in the following year, Allah will forgive his sins.

key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic calendar)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting Imam Husayn on the 15th of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) linking the spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) on the 15th of Sha'ban to the concept of 'Hawl' (a lunar year), ensuring no sins are recorded during this period. This tradition highlights the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt and the significance of Sha'ban as a month of divine mercy and preparation for Ramadan, reinforcing the Shia practice of seeking forgiveness through the progeny of the Prophet.
